description: Exact same-Z0 conjunction of ordinary zero-forcing rank, normal block support, and nonbipartite joint actual support.

quantifiers.Z0: every eligible size-at-most-six Z0 fails at least one of three systems; all three are evaluated on the same Z0
quantifiers.block: every bipartite component must pass a generic orientation or the separate lightlike alternative
quantifiers.nonbipartite: some light-ray coloring must have one joint support assignment
quantifiers.seed: one impossible required K6 seed rejects a graph
quantifiers.zero_forcing: every bipartite component must satisfy the ordinary zero-forcing span lower bound

semantics.allowed_defects: upper bounds; allowed coordinates may be zero
